title: Glowing volcano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffdd44'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6600' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lava' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe866'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff8800'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc2200'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='mountain' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8b5a3c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5a3a2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sky glow behind volcano -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='34' ry='20' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- volcano body -->
  <polygon points='50,20 18,82 82,82' fill='url(#mountain)' stroke='#a07050' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- shadow side of mountain -->
  <polygon points='50,20 50,82 82,82' fill='#4a2e20' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- crater rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='11' ry='5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='8' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8800'/>

  <!-- lava fountain -->
  <path d='M46,22 Q44,10 48,6 Q50,2 52,6 Q56,10 54,22' fill='url(#lava)' stroke='#ffaa00' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- lava blobs flying up -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='8' r='2' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='5' r='1.8' fill='#ff9900'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='2' r='1.5' fill='#ffee66'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#ff8800'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='15' r='1.3' fill='#ffcc33'/>

  <!-- lava flowing down the side -->
  <path d='M48,24 Q44,36 46,46 Q48,54 44,62 Q42,68 45,74' fill='none' stroke='#ff9900' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M48,24 Q44,36 46,46 Q48,54 44,62 Q42,68 45,74' fill='none' stroke='#ffdd55' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M54,24 Q58,34 55,44 Q53,50 56,58' fill='none' stroke='#ff8800' stroke-width='2.8' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M54,24 Q58,34 55,44 Q53,50 56,58' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc44' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M52,26 Q51,38 53,48' fill='none' stroke='#ff6600' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- lava pool at base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='30' ry='7' fill='#cc3300' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='24' ry='5' fill='#ff8800' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='16' ry='3.5' fill='#ffcc44' opacity='0.9'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='81' rx='8' ry='2' fill='#ffee88'/>

  <!-- little sparkle glints -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='30' r='1' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='0.8' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='55' r='0.9' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
